Mrs Jackson shares what she feels was Michael's biggest gift to the world.

The uncut segment, shows a gracious Mrs Jackson, as humble and loving off-record as she is on.

Mrs Jackson tackles her final question, about how she feels knowing that her son, will always be remembered as the Greatest Of All Time, marked in history.
